name: Padel Culture
heroText: Weekly Americano games, mixed levels and a crowd that stays for chai after. Pick a game, grab a spot, and we'll handle the pairings.
about: Padel Culture started because West Delhi had courts but no community. South Delhi has its collectives and weekly games; we wanted the same thing closer to home. We run social Americano games where you rotate partners every round, so you meet everyone on court and nobody needs to bring a fixed partner. Beginners are welcome at every game we tag as open level.
